Indian Railways Factory Sets New Record for Engine Production

A railway factory has produced 65 electric locomotive engines in 31 days, surpassing its previous record. This achievement was made by the Diesel Locomotive Works (DLW) in Varanasi, which is part of Indian Railways. The factory has broken its own historical record with this production rate.
